# Approved consumer wording — CCUS-SYN-2026.08.24 (synthetic training only)

**Status:** Synthetic approved wording for this training packet only. Not a real consumer notice library and not legal advice.

Each reason code has **exactly one** wording id and **exactly one** sentence. Do not paraphrase, nearest-match, or append a legal conclusion. Discriminatory or proxy wording is absent. Human review is required before any consumer-facing use in a demonstration that explicitly calls for a notice.

| wording_id | reason_code | Approved sentence |
|---|---|---|
| W-INC-AMT | CCUS-INC-AMT | Income is insufficient for the amount of credit requested. |
| W-INC-OBL | CCUS-INC-OBL | Existing credit obligations are excessive in relation to documented income. |
| W-EMP-LEN | CCUS-EMP-LEN | Length of current employment is insufficient relative to the requested term. |
| W-EMP-IRR | CCUS-EMP-IRR | Employment is temporary or irregular relative to repayment of the requested credit. |
| W-BUR-DLQ | CCUS-BUR-DLQ | Delinquent past or present credit obligations with other creditors. |
| W-BUR-THIN | CCUS-BUR-THIN | Limited credit experience. |
| W-BUR-NONE | CCUS-BUR-NONE | No credit file. |
| W-BUR-INQ | CCUS-BUR-INQ | Number of recent inquiries on the credit bureau report. |
| W-BUR-COLL | CCUS-BUR-COLL | Collection action or judgment. |
| W-BUR-BNK | CCUS-BUR-BNK | Bankruptcy. |
| W-AMT-MAX | CCUS-AMT-MAX | Requested amount exceeds the product maximum supported by documented income. |
| W-TERM-UNS | CCUS-TERM-UNS | Requested term is inconsistent with the product stated term criteria. |

## Refused wording (never approved)

- “Model score too low.”
- “Internal policy.”
- “Failed to achieve a qualifying score.”
- Any opaque ranking or unexplained score-only statement.
- Any wording that names or proxies race, color, religion, national origin, sex, marital status, age as a negative factor, ZIP/ZIP3, or public-assistance receipt as a denial reason in this fixture.
- Any post-hoc sentence that does not match the code the scorer emitted.
